tasks.title: Create model-qualification.ts
tasks.description:
NEW src/domain/model-qualification.ts. Validate snapshots, judge independence and secret guards. Tests: src/domain/model-qualification.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Secret guard bypass — Evidence and judging contract, credential invariants (contracts/evidence-and-lock.md:91).
  WHERE: src/domain/model-qualification.ts:296-312
  EXPECTED: Reject authorization and cookie headers in evidence strings and reject values with the listed credential prefixes.
  ACTUAL: Cookie: session=fixture-session, Authorization: Basic Zml4dHVyZQ== and sk-fixture pass without throwing. The header pattern matches JSON keys and the prefix pattern requires eight trailing characters.
  FIX: Detect textual authorization and cookie headers as well as structured keys. Reject the listed token prefixes and add regression cases for each bypass.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Incomplete judge verdict can promote — Spec acceptance 2 and evidence contract unanimous non-regression.
  WHERE: src/domain/model-qualification.ts:124-137,204-210,236-251
  EXPECTED: Each verdict includes observedJudgeModel, with "unknown" for an unreported model, and explicitly reports false for the candidate regression flag.
  ACTUAL: evaluatePromotion returns { promote: true } when observedJudgeModel is omitted. It also promotes when optionBRegression is omitted for candidate B.
  FIX: Require a nonempty observedJudgeModel and both boolean regression fields. Accept explicit "unknown" or the requested judge model. Require the candidate regression flag to equal false. Test omitted fields.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/model-qualification.ts — Update `assertNoSecretMaterial` to match `Authorization:`, `Cookie:`, and `Set-Cookie:` case-insensitively in evidence strings while retaining structured-key checks. Remove the eight-character suffix minimum from every credential prefix in `secretPattern`. Add separate throw assertions in `src/domain/model-qualification.test.ts` for `Cookie: session=fixture-session`, `Authorization: Basic Zml4dHVyZQ==`, `sk-fixture`, and short values for the other listed prefixes.
FIX: src/domain/model-qualification.ts — Make `JudgeVerdict.observedJudgeModel` a required `string`. In `evaluatePromotion`, accept only `"unknown"` or the exact requested `judge.modelId`. Require both regression fields to be booleans and the candidate’s field to equal `false`. Update the valid judge fixture in `src/domain/model-qualification.test.ts` and add runtime cases that independently omit each required field. Cover both candidate positions and both accepted model values.
FIX: specs/047-model-qualification/gates/phase-01.sh — Keep `src/domain/model-qualification.test.ts` in the mandatory `vitest run` list. Run the gate with the new credential and verdict regressions before changing domain code. Verify that each bypass fails before the fix and passes afterward.
FIX: src/ports/model-qualification-port.ts — Give `SmokeProbeRequest` flat `backend: string`, `modelId: string`, and `effort?: string` fields. Give `SmokeProbeEvidence` flat `backend: string`, `requestedModel: string`, and `requestedEffort?: string` fields. Set `FixtureRepeatRequest.route` to `{ backend: string; modelId: string; effort?: string }` and replace `FixtureRepeatEvidence.requested` with `requestedModel: string`. Export `StructuredJudgeVerdict` with `judgeBackend`, `judgeProvider`, `judgeFamily`, `judgeModelId`, and required `observedJudgeModel` as strings. Include `winner`, both boolean regression flags, `scores`, and `citations`. Return `Promise<StructuredJudgeVerdict>` from `PromotionJudgePort.judgeComparison` and map the flat judge identity to `JudgeVerdict.judge` at the application boundary before promotion. Update `src/adapters/models/smoke-probe.ts` and `src/adapters/models/smoke-probe.test.ts` to use the flat request and evidence fields.
FIX: specs/047-model-qualification/gates/phase-01.sh — Add `src/ports/model-qualification-port.contract.test.ts` with typed consumer calls for `runSmokeProbe`, `runFixtureRepeat`, and `judgeComparison`. Assert that all three return the documented fields and that a judge verdict with `observedJudgeModel` omitted fails type checking. Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext src/ports/model-qualification-port.contract.test.ts` in the gate. Verify the check fails against the old signatures and passes after the port changes.

Verification: phase tests reject malformed persisted verdicts, non-boolean gate results and missing judge fields. The credential tests cover header strings and token prefixes.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Malformed promotion evidence passes — Model qualification acceptance 2 and evidence contract rules for repeat calibration, judge independence and citation completeness.
  WHERE: src/domain/model-qualification.ts:176-190,196-218,223-246
  EXPECTED: Required fixture IDs, judge backend identities and all three citation references are nonempty strings. Each reference must match a supplied artifact of its kind.
  ACTUAL: evaluatePromotion returns { promote: true } for each persisted JSON case: a required fixture and three repeats with fixtureId "", a judge with backend omitted, and citations with null references matched by refs arrays containing null.
  FIX: Validate fixture IDs, judge backend and artifact references before counting repeats or accepting verdicts. Add one rejection case for each payload to the Phase 01 gate.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/domain/model-qualification.ts — Retain the case-insensitive `Authorization:`, `Cookie:` and `Set-Cookie:` text checks and the structured-key checks in `assertNoSecretMaterial`. Keep credential prefixes independent of suffix length. Keep the separate header and short-prefix regression cases in `src/domain/model-qualification.test.ts`.
FIX: src/domain/model-qualification.ts — Keep `JudgeVerdict.observedJudgeModel` required. Accept only `"unknown"` or `judge.modelId`. Require boolean `optionARegression` and `optionBRegression` values and require the candidate’s flag to equal `false`. Keep the omitted-field and accepted-model tests for candidates A and B.
FIX: src/domain/model-qualification.ts — In `evaluatePromotion`, reject blank or non-string required and repeat fixture IDs as `insufficient-repeats` before counting. Reject missing, blank or non-string `judge.backend` as `judge-dependence`. Reject blank or non-string `inputRef`, `outputRef` and `gateRef` as `invalid-citations` before checking membership in the corresponding artifact sets.
FIX: specs/047-model-qualification/gates/phase-01.sh — Keep `src/domain/model-qualification.test.ts` in the mandatory Vitest run. Add separate persisted-JSON cases there for an empty required fixture ID with three matching repeats, an omitted judge backend and null citation refs with matching null artifact entries. Verify each new case fails before the domain fix and passes afterward.
FIX: src/ports/model-qualification-port.ts — Keep the flat smoke request fields `backend`, `modelId` and `effort?` and the flat evidence fields `backend`, `requestedModel` and `requestedEffort?`. Keep `FixtureRepeatRequest.route` flat and `FixtureRepeatEvidence.requestedModel` a `string`. Keep `judgeComparison` returning `Promise<StructuredJudgeVerdict>` with required `observedJudgeModel: string`. In `src/application/models/evaluate-models.ts`, map `judgeBackend`, `judgeProvider`, `judgeFamily` and `judgeModelId` into `JudgeVerdict.judge` before calling `evaluatePromotion`.
FIX: src/ports/model-qualification-port.ts — Return `Promise<AdapterDiscoveryReport[]>` from `discoverCatalog`. Accept `snapshot: unknown` in `writeDiscoverySnapshot`. Expose `writeRouteLockAtomic(scope: RunnerScope, lock: unknown): Promise<string>`. In `specs/047-model-qualification/contracts/qualification-ports.md`, define the write payload as `{ document: unknown; expectedIncumbentDigest: string | null }`. Require the store to validate it and compare the digest under the same lock used for the write. Reject with `incumbent-changed` on mismatch and return the new digest on success.
FIX: specs/047-model-qualification/gates/phase-01.sh — Keep the strict `tsc --noEmit` check on `src/ports/model-qualification-port.contract.test.ts`. Extend that fixture to assign discovery to `AdapterDiscoveryReport[]`, pass an `unknown` snapshot and assign the awaited two-argument lock write to `string`. Retain the smoke, fixture and judge consumer checks, including the omitted-`observedJudgeModel` type assertion. Verify the new checks fail against the old signatures and pass after the fix.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Malformed repeat records permit promotion — Model qualification acceptance 2 and evidence contract repeat calibration (contracts/evidence-and-lock.md:21).
  WHERE: src/domain/model-qualification.ts:175-199
  EXPECTED: Every repeat record has a nonnegative safe-integer repeatIndex. Missing or nonnumeric indices make the evidence ineligible even when three other repeats pass.
  ACTUAL: Number.isSafeInteger(repeat.repeatIndex) only filters records out of the count. Three valid repeats plus a fourth repeat with repeatIndex omitted or set to "3" both return { promote: true }.
  FIX: Reject malformed indices across the entire repeat array before counting distinct indices for required fixtures. Add both persisted JSON cases to the phase gate.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, REVIEW FAIL block appended, status left unchanged):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.
